content: .{@-अध्वन्@} {%a.%} .²1 one who has accomplished or finished a journey; बलैरध्युषितास्तस्य विजिगीषोर्गताध्वनः <ls>R. 4. 46</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 33</ls>. .²2 conversant, familiar (with anything); त्रिविधे मोक्षधर्मेऽस्मिन्गताध्वा छिन्नसंशयः <ls>Mb. 12. 320. 25</ls>. --({%f.%}) the time immediately preceding new moon when a small streak of the moon is still visible; (चतुर्दशीयुक्ताऽमावास्या).
